lines.msg: Remote control re-enabled for RS-21 and RS-22. All operator commands and remote setpoint updates are now active.
Alarms restored: RS21-PT-OUT and RS22-PT-OUT now show 10 in. w.c. on HMI.
Polling and telemetry resumed for all RTUs in Pressure District 7. RS-21 and RS-22 now receiving remote setpoint updates.
Field gauge at RS-22 confirms 10 in. w.c. — no discrepancy with SCADA. All remote commands are enabled.
System status: Remote control active. Wait for next instruction before any further action.
